messages:
Ashley: Morning handoff — quick notes for the 08:00 shift. I'm on for the next 4h, Mike takes over at 12:00. Matt is OOO today.
Ashley: Key things to watch: 1) small rollout of quantized-v2 model to dedicated pool at ~09:30 UTC; 2) expected short burst from ACME staging 11:00-11:45; 3) a routing tweak PR in canary touching prefetched keys.
Ashley: Deploy details from deploy-bot below so you have commands if you need to roll back.
```
deploy-bot: deploy quantized-v2 -> dedicated-pool/gpool-12 @ 2026-03-18T09:30Z
cmd: redwoodctl rollout cancel --pool gpool-12 --tag quantized-v2
``` 
sre-bot: Scheduled maintenance: kernel patch applied to gpool-12 at 09:35 UTC (window 09:30-09:40). No expected service restarts. :information_source:
Mike: Roger. I'll watch p95 and p99 for the dedicated pool during rollout. Where's the runbook? :eyes:
Ashley: Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/quantized-rollouts — check "rollback quick-steps" section. Also watch "kv-eviction-rate" metric.
Jordan: PR #3421 (routing:prefetch) is in canary and has been running for ~2h with no obvious latency blips. It *does* increase short-request traffic to cpu-fallback by ~4% in canary though.
Priya: FYI ACME test will hammer short prompts (<= 32 tokens) with ~2000 req/min bursts. That historically moves routing to cpu-fallback if burst concurrent > 800. :rotating_light:
Mike: Thanks — i'll set an alert to lower the cpu-fallback threshold temporarily if we see >600 concurrent CPU fallbacks. Also will shadow route to canary to confirm.
Sam: Quick heads-up — I pinged @Mike on the CR for auto-batching tuning (PR #3478). If not approved before 10:30 it blocks next nightkeeper deploy.
Mike: Saw that, will review by 10:00. If I can't, tag Jordan to pair-review.
Ashley: Action items: (A) Mike: monitor p95/p99 + kv-evictions during 09:30 rollout; (B) Mike/Priya: watch ACME window and adjust cpu-fallback threshold if needed; (C) Jordan: keep an eye on PR3421 telemetry in canary; (D) Sam: follow up on CR approval timeline.
Ashley: FYI no elevated alerts currently. If anything spikes, post here and escalate to incident channel. :thumbsup:
Jordan: I'll post a short telemetry snapshot if we see the 4% shift worsen.
Priya: I'll be on standby for the ACME window. Paging in #support if they hit anything unexpected.
Mike: Copy. Will hand over notes in the 11:50 check-in to whoever is next after me. :white_check_mark:
Ashley: Thanks team — leaving this thread pinned to today's watchlist.
